# Specter

> Automated website change monitor with AI-assisted setup, deterministic scheduled checks, and visual diff tracking.

Specter turns a URL and a plain-language prompt into a scheduled web monitor. AI inspects the page to build and repair extraction plans, while routine checks run deterministically with no LLM calls.

## Key Capabilities
- **Visual Diff Tracking**: Capture page snapshots and compare them side-by-side with an interactive comparison slider.
- **Scheduled Monitoring**: Configure automated checks on custom cron schedules with a 15-minute minimum interval.
- **Instant Alerts**: Dispatch notifications to Telegram, custom Webhooks (Discord, Slack, Zapier), and email.
- **Self-Healing Plans**: Detect layout changes and automatically revise broken selectors with version history and rollback.
